---
title: "Atlas"
subtitle: "Explore how California water-data innovation has evolved across place, time, and theme."
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

<style>
  .atlas-shell {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    font-family: inherit;
  }
  .atlas-controls {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
  }
  .atlas-control {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.35rem;
  }
  .atlas-control label {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .atlas-control input,
  .atlas-control select {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.58rem 0.7rem;
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #fff;
  }
  .atlas-section {
    margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #fff;
  }
  .atlas-section h2 {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
  .atlas-map-panel {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 1.2fr) minmax(220px, 0.8fr);
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  .atlas-map-wrap {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 320px;
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #f8fafc;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .atlas-map-wrap svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
  }
  .atlas-map-legend {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    max-height: 320px;
    overflow: auto;
  }
  .atlas-chip {
    display: inline-block;
    margin: 0.2rem 0.35rem 0.2rem 0;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #edf4ff;
    color: #1f2937;
    border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
  .atlas-chip.active {
    background: #2563eb;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #2563eb;
  }
  .atlas-timeline {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.9rem;
    min-height: 220px;
    padding: 1.25rem 0.75rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #f8fafc;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  }
  .atlas-bar-wrap {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    min-width: 52px;
    height: 190px;
  }
  .atlas-bar {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 56px;
    min-height: 8px;
    background: #6a86a9;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease, opacity 0.18s ease;
    opacity: 0.95;
  }
  .atlas-bar:hover,
  .atlas-bar:focus-visible {
    background: #4f6f96;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    outline: none;
  }
  .atlas-bar.active {
    background: #3c5b84;
  }
  .atlas-bar-label {
    margin-top: 0.6rem;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: #4b5563;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .atlas-bar-count {
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    color: #374151;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .atlas-keywords {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 0.7rem;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 180px;
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #f8fafc;
  }
  .atlas-word {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08);
    color: #1f2937;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  .atlas-results {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  .atlas-card {
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #fff;
  }
  .atlas-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 0.45rem;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
  }
  .atlas-meta {
    font-size: 0.84rem;
    color: #4b5563;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }
  .atlas-card p {
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0.75rem;
  }
  .atlas-empty {
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #f8fafc;
    color: #374151;
  }
  .atlas-note {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: #4b5563;
    margin-top: 0.75rem;
  }
</style>

<div class="atlas-shell">
<p><strong>Explore how California water-data innovation has evolved across place, time, and theme.</strong></p>

<div class="atlas-controls">
<div class="atlas-control">
<label for="atlas-year-filter">Year</label>
<select id="atlas-year-filter">
<option value="all">All years</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="atlas-control">
<label for="atlas-topic-filter">Topic</label>
<select id="atlas-topic-filter">
<option value="all">All topics</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="atlas-control">
<label for="atlas-location-filter">Location</label>
<select id="atlas-location-filter">
<option value="all">All locations</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="atlas-control">
<label for="atlas-search">Search</label>
<input id="atlas-search" type="text" placeholder="Search projects, teams, topics" />
</div>
</div>

<div class="atlas-section">
<h2>WHERE — Explore by Place</h2>
<div class="atlas-map-panel">
<div id="atlas-map" class="atlas-map-wrap"></div>
<div id="atlas-map-legend" class="atlas-map-legend"></div>
</div>
<div class="atlas-note">Spatial representation is intentionally conservative. Projects without a documented spatial footprint are grouped at the California statewide level instead of being assigned arbitrary points.</div>
</div>

<div class="atlas-section">
<h2>WHEN — Explore by Time</h2>
<div id="atlas-timeline" class="atlas-timeline"></div>
</div>

<div class="atlas-section">
<h2>WHAT — Explore by Theme</h2>
<div id="atlas-keywords" class="atlas-keywords"></div>
</div>

<div class="atlas-section">
<h2>Projects</h2>
<div id="atlas-results" class="atlas-results"></div>
</div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const state = {
    allProjects: [],
    year: 'all',
    topic: 'all',
    location: 'all',
    keyword: 'all',
    search: ''
  };

  const yearFilter = document.getElementById('atlas-year-filter');
  const topicFilter = document.getElementById('atlas-topic-filter');
  const locationFilter = document.getElementById('atlas-location-filter');
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('atlas-search');
  const mapEl = document.getElementById('atlas-map');
  const mapLegendEl = document.getElementById('atlas-map-legend');
  const timelineEl = document.getElementById('atlas-timeline');
  const keywordsEl = document.getElementById('atlas-keywords');
  const resultsEl = document.getElementById('atlas-results');

  function normalizeProject(project) {
    const topicList = Array.isArray(project.topic_list)
      ? project.topic_list
      : (String(project.topics || '')
          .split('|')
          .map(v => v.replace(/['"]/g, '').replace(/^Topic:\s*/i, '').trim())
          .filter(Boolean));
    const keywordList = Array.isArray(project.keywords)
      ? project.keywords
      : (Array.isArray(project.keyword_list) ? project.keyword_list : []);

    return {
      ...project,
      year: project.year ? Number(project.year) : null,
      topic_list: topicList,
      keywords: keywordList,
      keyword_list: keywordList,
      location: project.spatial_category || 'California statewide',
      description: (project.description || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      team: project.team_name || project.team_members || 'Unknown team'
    };
  }

  function uniqueSorted(values) {
    return Array.from(new Set(values.filter(Boolean))).sort();
  }

  function filterProjects() {
    const q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return state.allProjects.filter(project => {
      const yearOk = state.year === 'all' || String(project.year) === String(state.year);
      const topicOk = state.topic === 'all' || project.topic_list.includes(state.topic);
      const locationOk = state.location === 'all' || project.location === state.location;
      const projectKeywords = Array.isArray(project.keywords) ? project.keywords : [];
      const keywordOk = state.keyword === 'all' || projectKeywords.includes(state.keyword);
      const searchText = [project.title, project.team, project.description, project.topic_list.join(' '), project.event, projectKeywords.join(' ')].join(' ').toLowerCase();
      const textOk = !q || searchText.includes(q);
      return yearOk && topicOk && locationOk && keywordOk && textOk;
    });
  }

  function renderControls() {
    const years = uniqueSorted(state.allProjects.map(p => p.year).filter(v => v !== null)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    yearFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="all">All years</option>' + years.map(y => `<option value="${y}">${y}</option>`).join('');
    yearFilter.value = state.year;

    const topics = uniqueSorted(state.allProjects.flatMap(p => p.topic_list));
    topicFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="all">All topics</option>' + topics.map(t => `<option value="${t}">${t}</option>`).join('');
    topicFilter.value = state.topic;

    const locations = uniqueSorted(state.allProjects.map(p => p.location));
    locationFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="all">All locations</option>' + locations.map(l => `<option value="${l}">${l}</option>`).join('');
    locationFilter.value = state.location;
  }

  function renderMap(projects) {
    const counts = {};
    projects.forEach(project => {
      counts[project.location] = (counts[project.location] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const locationEntries = Object.entries(counts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    mapLegendEl.innerHTML = locationEntries.length
      ? locationEntries.map(([location, count]) => `
          <button class="atlas-chip ${state.location === location ? 'active' : ''}" data-location="${location}">
            ${location}: ${count}
          </button>
        `).join('')
      : '<div class="atlas-empty">No matching project locations.</div>';

    mapLegendEl.querySelectorAll('[data-location]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const next = button.dataset.location;
        state.location = state.location === next ? 'all' : next;
        renderAll();
      });
    });

    const svg = `
      <svg viewBox="0 0 520 300" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" role="img" aria-label="California context map">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="520" height="300" fill="#f8fafc" />
        <path d="M96 58 L132 40 L166 54 L214 48 L262 60 L292 84 L324 80 L358 92 L400 116 L430 144 L444 188 L430 226 L410 238 L390 262 L354 254 L322 236 L298 220 L254 226 L208 214 L170 224 L140 198 L118 180 L90 150 L82 116 L96 58 Z" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
        <text x="230" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="#1f2937" font-weight="600">California</text>
        <text x="230" y="178" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#4b5563">${projects.length} matching projects</text>
        ${locationEntries.slice(0, 6).map(([location, count], index) => {
          const x = 120 + (index % 3) * 120;
          const y = 210 + Math.floor(index / 3) * 40;
          return `<g><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${Math.max(10, 8 + count * 2)}" fill="#22c55e" opacity="0.8" /><text x="${x + 18}" y="${y + 4}" font-size="12" fill="#1f2937">${count}</text></g>`;
        }).join('')}
      </svg>
    `;

    mapEl.innerHTML = svg;
  }

  function renderTimeline(projects) {
    const countsByYear = {};
    projects.forEach(project => {
      if (project.year) countsByYear[project.year] = (countsByYear[project.year] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const years = Object.keys(countsByYear).map(Number).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const maxCount = years.length ? Math.max(...years.map(y => countsByYear[y])) : 0;

    if (!years.length) {
      timelineEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">No projects match the selected filters.</div>';
      return;
    }

    timelineEl.innerHTML = years.map(year => {
      const count = countsByYear[year];
      const height = maxCount ? (count / maxCount) * 140 + 10 : 10;
      const active = state.year === String(year);
      const barClass = active ? 'atlas-bar active' : 'atlas-bar';
      return `
        <div class="atlas-bar-wrap">
          <div class="atlas-bar-count">${count}</div>
          <button class="${barClass}" data-year="${year}" title="${year} — ${count} projects" style="height:${height}px;"></button>
          <div class="atlas-bar-label">${year}</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');

    timelineEl.querySelectorAll('[data-year]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const next = button.dataset.year;
        state.year = state.year === next ? 'all' : next;
        renderAll();
      });
    });
  }

  function renderKeywords(projects) {
    const counts = {};
    projects.forEach(project => {
      const projectKeywords = Array.isArray(project.keywords) ? project.keywords : [];
      projectKeywords.forEach(keyword => {
        const clean = String(keyword || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!clean) return;
        counts[clean] = (counts[clean] || 0) + 1;
      });
    });

    const entries = Object.entries(counts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 24);
    if (!entries.length) {
      keywordsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">No theme keywords are available for the current selection.</div>';
      return;
    }

    const max = entries[0][1];
    keywordsEl.innerHTML = entries.map(([word, count]) => {
      const size = 0.8 + (count / max) * 1.7;
      const active = state.keyword === word ? 'background:#2563eb;color:#fff;' : '';
      return `<button class="atlas-word" data-keyword="${word}" style="font-size:${size.toFixed(2)}rem;${active}">${word}</button>`;
    }).join('');

    keywordsEl.querySelectorAll('[data-keyword]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const next = button.dataset.keyword;
        state.keyword = state.keyword === next ? 'all' : next;
        renderAll();
      });
    });
  }

  function renderResults(projects) {
    if (!projects.length) {
      resultsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">No projects match the current filters.</div>';
      return;
    }

    resultsEl.innerHTML = projects.map(project => `
      <div class="atlas-card">
        <h3><a href="${project.project_url || '#'}">${project.title || 'Untitled project'}</a></h3>
        <div class="atlas-meta">${project.year || 'Unknown year'} • ${project.team || 'Unknown team'} • ${project.location || 'California statewide'}</div>
        <div class="atlas-meta">${project.topic_list.length ? project.topic_list.join(' • ') : 'No topic listed'}</div>
        <p>${project.description ? (project.description.length > 280 ? project.description.slice(0, 280) + '…' : project.description) : 'No description available.'}</p>
        <a href="${project.project_url || '#'}">Open project page</a>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  }

  function renderAll() {
    const filtered = filterProjects();
    renderControls();
    renderMap(filtered);
    renderTimeline(filtered);
    renderKeywords(filtered);
    renderResults(filtered);
  }

  async function loadData() {
    const response = await fetch('atlas-projects.json');
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Atlas data is missing. Run the R script to generate docs/atlas-projects.json.');
    }
    const projects = await response.json();
    state.allProjects = (projects || []).map(normalizeProject);
    renderAll();
  }

  yearFilter.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
    state.year = event.target.value;
    renderAll();
  });
  topicFilter.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
    state.topic = event.target.value;
    renderAll();
  });
  locationFilter.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
    state.location = event.target.value;
    renderAll();
  });
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
    state.search = event.target.value;
    renderAll();
  });

  loadData().catch(error => {
    resultsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">' + error.message + '</div>';
    mapEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Map unavailable because the Atlas data file is missing.</div>';
    timelineEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Timeline unavailable because the Atlas data file is missing.</div>';
    keywordsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Theme cloud unavailable because the Atlas data file is missing.</div>';
  });
})();
</script>

<p class="atlas-note">This MVP uses the repository’s official project workbook as the source of truth and only derives a lightweight Atlas dataset for interactive filtering and exploration. More detailed geographic footprints can be added later without altering the underlying project pages.</p>
